name: Proximal Tibiofibular Joint Instability
definition: Symptomatic instability or subluxation of the proximal tibiofibular joint causing lateral knee pain.

investigations.principle: Radiographs/CT assess alignment; MRI evaluates associated soft-tissue injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, postoperative, infection, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Persistent mechanical instability may require surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu/Jangha Sandhi-asthirata phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Symptomatic instability or subluxation of the proximal tibiofibular joint causing lateral knee pain.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, major trauma, unstable fracture/dislocation, sepsis/infection or other listed red flags.
